model: empty integer loads;2 communities,q=2m each; uniform internal K_m,m; global-left tie; epsilon=lambda/q; integer c=q/2; n*=q^2
seeds: protocol/SEEDS_V1.txt; exact1024 labels fixed before execution, prefixes by scale; no replacement, extension or selection
driver: counter SplitMix64 mixing,2 words per arrival; exact disjoint power-of2 bit fields for event type/direction/endpoints under the ideal uniform-word reference; same words across both kernels and across cells with the same replicate label
horizon: q^2+2q arrivals per paired trajectory; one fixed/product pair per(q,lambda,seed)
feedback_checkpoints: 16 points n=q^2/2+2q*floor[(q/4-1)j/15]+(2q*j)/16,j=0..15; common phases exactlyj/16, compared pointwise with the phase-aware wave, not with gbar
spill_times: n=q^2+2hq; retain capacity integer phase and actual d=Delta/q
wave_lookup: piecewise linear probability tails from the existing257 saved phase nodes; E+e+1/256^2 bounds marginal-pair W1 interpolation; separately budget arithmetic

primary_predictions.metric: trajectory RMS of exact conditional kernel feedback minus phase-aware wave feedback over16 checkpoints
trajectory max over5 h values of |Z/q-S_h(actual Delta/q)|

statistical_contract.method: certain/possible failure indicators include numerical allowance; exact binomial tails and conservative0.001-grid Clopper-Pearson bounds for10 largest-scale cells; all other scales descriptive
statistical_contract.universality_comparisons: largest-scale fixed/product endpoint CDFs of Delta/q and Z/q,lambda1 and2:4 comparisons
statistical_contract.DKW_check: 16exp(-2*1024*(57/1000)^2)<=1/40, proved with rational Taylor lower exp bound
statistical_contract.decision: upper bound<=margin supports specified finite-size criterion; lower bound>margin rejects it; otherwise inconclusive. Nonrejection is not certification.

secondary: profile W1, fixed pairing-vs-product response decomposition, cluster means/MCSE, geometric size trends; no post-result threshold promotion
stopping: stop on code invariant failure or budget; retain partial outputs and every seed status; no replacement/retry or inference from incomplete planned batch
pre_run_checks: compile frozen source; deterministic exhaustive one-step driver/feedback tests and capped-vs-uncapped identity; verify wave lookup budget; only then run model once
raw_outputs: all trajectory summaries; all predetermined checkpoint side histograms and fixed joint load tables in32MiB observation parts; all5 spill readouts; critical full labelled configurations; driver hashes; complete logs and exact reproducible commands
statistical_interpretation: iid replicate guarantees refer to the declared ideal independent-stream model. Fixed pseudorandom streams are reproducible, not a proof that machine-generated words are iid.
limits: finite sample checks do not prove an asymptotic theorem, all fixed kernels, actual dictionary performance, or a finite-q rate; old experiments remain separate
